name: Mcp Governance Continuous Institutional Process
text: MCP governance should be treated as a continuous institutional process, not as a sequence of static specification releases. Server behavior, tool permissions, and observed failure data should feed a review mechanism that can update rules while preserving an auditable record.
scope_conditions: MCP server discovery, authorization, tool permission, and protocol governance where behavior data and auditable review are available.
